login.title: Two-step verification

settings.title: Two-step verification
settings.description: Add an extra layer of security to your account with an authenticator app.
settings.scanInstructions: Scan with Google Authenticator, Authy, or a similar app, then enter the 6-digit code below to confirm.
settings.enableSuccessMessage: Your account is now protected with an extra verification step at sign-in.
